title: 📅 Sign up for 2026-27 high school intramural basketball
text:
1 days ago 📢 Sign up for the 2026-2027 High School Intramural Basketball League
The High School Intramural Basketball League is back for 2026-2027 .
Who can play: Boys and girls in grades 9–12 from the West Essex area Where: West Essex Middle School , North Caldwell When: Games on Friday evenings Cost: $150 per player Registration limit: Closes after the first 96 registered players or by November 11 at 11:30pm , whichever comes first After 96 players or the deadline, a wait list will be started and players may be added if space opens based on roster size.
How to register:
Sign up online through Community Pass at http://register.communitypass.net/roseland Questions?
Call the Recreation Department at 973-403-6822 Or email Patricia Gentile at recdirector@roselandnj.org More Info: 2026-2027 High School Intramural Basketball League...
